decision: Selected the centroid of Mecklenburg County tax parcel 08008408 (125 N MYERS ST), as published in the NC OneMap statewide parcel layer, as the reviewed site locator for TierPoint's Charlotte - North Myers (CL2) data center at 125 North Myers Street, Charlotte. The parcel is the host building's lot; TierPoint's facility may occupy only part of the building.
layer: NC OneMap NC1Map_Parcels FeatureServer layer 1 (Mecklenburg County source rows); native CRS EPSG:2264 (NAD83 / North Carolina, US feet)

excluded.08008405: 113 N MYERS ST, 0.37 acres, OFFICE, structure 1999, owner of record DIGITAL 113 N MYERS LLC (local nconemap-meck-digital-myers-owner.json): the adjoining building of a related owner entity at a different street number; TierPoint gives 125 North Myers Street only, so it is not part of the locator.

operator_structured_data_point_check.falls_in: parcel 08008215 (241 N ALEXANDER ST, OTHER MUNICIPAL, 2.49 acres; local nconemap-meck-tierpoint-cl2-jsonld-point-parcel.json)
operator_structured_data_point_check.use: not used; an approximate geocode on a neighbouring municipal parcel

computed.method: Planar centroid of the WGS84 (outSR=4326) parcel polygon (one record, one ring); cross-checked against the native EPSG:2264 centroid transformed with pyproj; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid.

identity_bridge: TierPoint's Charlotte - North Myers page (version of 3 September 2026) gives 'Charlotte - North Myers (CL2) 125 North Myers Street Charlotte, NC 28202'.

NC OneMap returns one Mecklenburg parcel with site address 125 N MYERS ST (08008408; 0.20 acres; OFFICE; structure built in 2000) among the 42 N Myers St records (local nconemap-meck-n-myers-st-addresses.json).
unresolved: The point marks the host building's 0.2-acre lot, not TierPoint's suite; the statewide layer publishes no positional accuracy.
The owner of record is DIGITAL 125 N MYERS LLC; whether other operators occupy the building is not established here, and no owner role is asserted.
